notes.title: Minor update: added more tips
notes.content: Added a tip that recommends starting a new run on a higher difficulty mode after surviving 20 waves.

notes.title: Minor update: camera scrolling speed and more camera tips
notes.content:
Added an option to control the camera's movement speed when moving your mouse to the edges of the screen. 

Added additional tips for moving, zooming and rotating the camera.

notes.title: Citadelic is now available
notes.content:
Survive against waves of constantly evolving enemies while expanding your base and managing resources. Make your choices wisely and adapt your strategy, because every run is different from the last.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Citadelic releases on February 17
notes.content: Play the demo and add the game to your wishlist!

notes.title: Citadelic demo update: stats and UX improvements
notes.content:
A new update to the demo version of Citadelic has been released. It includes the following changes:

[list]
[*] Statistics are shown at the end of each run.
[*] Active upgrades and augments of a structure are now visible when moving your cursor over it.
[*] Camera rotation sensitivity can be changed in the Settings. The tooltip there also explains that middle mouse button can be held in-game to rotate the camera.
[*] Game controller hints are not visible if the player is using a mouse when a controller is plugged in.
[*] Minor text changes when selecting modifiers and difficulty.
[*] Camera is zoomed in closer to the game area by default.
[*] Structure customization tooltips now show a hint that right click can be used to unselect the structure.
[*] Keyboard can be used to close in-game tooltips and panels (backspace by default).
[/list]

notes.title: Game speed selection
notes.content:
This update includes a new gameplay feature, which lets the player toggle between Normal and Fast game speed modes during battle.

The game speed switch is found under the status bar at the top of the screen, and can be quickly toggled using a keyboard hotkey or gamepad button.

notes.title: Improvements for integrated graphics
notes.content: This update includes fixes for some visual glitches that appeared on some laptops when rendering the game without a dedicated GPU. This could happen, for example, when running the game in battery-saving mode.

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
- Fixed a rare bug that could cause a crash. (Thanks to Retromation for finding this!)
- Added more tips for beginners.
- Reduced background transparency for tooltips to improve readability.

notes.title: Demo is now available!
notes.content:
The first demo version of the game is now available!

The demo includes 2 difficulty modes and lets you play up to 15 waves per run. You can play as many runs as you want, and each one will be different.

Give it a try!
